camera_convention: q maps column camera vectors to world; t is world camera center; row world_to_camera=(world-t)@q
proposal_source: Saved output of upstream learned six-view proposal model; NOT recomputed by this bundle. Required explicit input, not GT pose.
sample_scope: Real CARLA crop/native-mask/calibration/reference subset, existing learned proposals. No new capture, training replication or naked-RGB inference claim.
